contracts.description: Design services proposal (Phase 1) for two industrial buildings (Building 3 ~231,000 SF and Building 4 ~105,000 SF) at the Harrison Township, NJ Industrial Campus. Scope covers architectural concept design and documentation for zoning and land development approvals, including preliminary design drawings, 3D renderings, building elevations, and Township/Planning Board meeting attendance. Work to be performed on a lump sum basis within six months of authorization.

line_items.description: Concept and Land Development Approvals – Architectural: Preliminary design drawings (floor plan, roof plan, elevations), 3D design studies, Land Development submittal documents including renderings, building code analysis, and coordination with civil engineer
